name: Shio Butchers
description: Shio Butchers is a calm, photographic WordPress store theme crafted for independent butcher shops and whole-carcass craft counters. Built with clean editorial typography in Schibsted Grotesk and Albert Sans, it features ruled category index rails, brass corner tabs, and a structured day schedule for pickup orders. The theme supports pickup workflows, newsletter announcements, and optional WooCommerce integration with radius-zero brass styling.
